title: Wrangler deploy --env production ships without the vars, KV, or D1 bindings defined at the top level
symptoms: env.DB is undefined in the production environment Worker
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
Variables visible in the default deploy are missing under --env
cause: Bindings and vars are non inheritable keys in Wrangler config, so a named environment gets none of the top level values. Each environment needs its own copy.
fix: Repeat vars and every binding block inside each [env.NAME] section, pointing at that environment's resources.
apply:
[env.production]
name = "my-worker-production"
vars = { API_HOST = "api.example.com" }
[[env.production.d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_name = "prod-db"
database_id = "YOUR_DB_ID"
affected: Wrangler 3 and 4 with named environments, as of October 2026
